subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-party Control UI/memory feature now, folded into the broader memory-file panel, or deferred until the Control UI plugin contribution-slot RFC defines a panel seam?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose the storage, stale-fact, injection, and browser write contract for persistent user context that can steer future agent behavior.

options.title: Keep Canonical Pinned-Facts Design
options.body: Use this issue to settle the pinned-fact storage, injection, stale-fact, diff/audit, and security contract before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Memory Panel
options.body: Make the first version part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46809 if maintainers want MEMORY.md and USER.md editing to own the UX.

options.title: Defer To Plugin Panel Seam
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736 if maintainers want memory/context panels to be plugin-contributed instead of core-owned.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Pinned-Facts Design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle the pinned-fact storage, injection, stale-fact, diff/audit, and security contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history signal across the Agents files UI, gateway file boundary, and memory/context routing areas.
